o.norm: Wraps the string in a custom {@link CharSequence}. This ensures that using the {@link Object#equals(Object)} method on the input CharSequence to test for equality will fail. @param string the string @return the char sequence

i.norm: Verifies that {@link JaroWinklerSimilarity#apply(SimilarityInput, SimilarityInput)} rejects a {@code null} input.
The contract states both inputs must be non-null; passing a null first argument must raise an IllegalArgumentException.
